ddl: venue(v INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, hall TEXT)
showing(v INTEGER, film TEXT, day TEXT, seats INTEGER)

cases.question: List film names for showings with exactly zero seats sold. Keep repeated names.
cases.sql: SELECT film FROM showing WHERE seats=0

cases.question: How many different named films have a showing?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film) FROM showing

cases.question: For each venue id in showing give its id and total seats sold.
cases.sql: SELECT v,SUM(seats) FROM showing GROUP BY v

cases.question: List the hall name for every showing with more than five seats sold.
cases.sql: SELECT hall FROM venue JOIN showing USING(v) WHERE seats>5

cases.question: How many showings fall in March 2024?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM showing WHERE day>='2024-03-01' AND day<'2024-04-01'

cases.question: Give each venue id and its number of showings, including empty venues.
cases.sql: SELECT a.v,COUNT(b.v) FROM venue a LEFT JOIN showing b ON b.v=a.v GROUP BY a.v

ddl: node(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,parent INTEGER,layer TEXT)

cases.question: Which destination ids had an unknown latency? Keep duplicates.
cases.sql: SELECT dest FROM ping WHERE ms IS NULL

cases.question: Count distinct parent node ids recorded in the topology.
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT parent) FROM node

cases.question: For each destination in the log report its id and minimum known latency.
cases.sql: SELECT dest, MIN(ms) FROM ping GROUP BY dest

cases.question: List each child id and its parent's layer when the parent exists.
cases.sql: SELECT c.id,p.layer FROM node c JOIN node p ON c.parent=p.id

cases.question: Which latencies were recorded in January 2024? Include missing measurements and duplicates.
cases.sql: SELECT ms FROM ping WHERE stamp>='2024-01-01' AND stamp<'2024-02-01'

cases.question: For every node give its id and number of direct children, even if zero.
cases.sql: SELECT p.id,COUNT(c.id) FROM node p LEFT JOIN node c ON c.parent=p.id GROUP BY p.id

ddl: roll(lot TEXT, part INTEGER, shade TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(lot,part))

cases.question: Give lot and part for cuts measuring at least three metres, with duplicates.
cases.sql: SELECT lot,part FROM cut WHERE metres>=3

cases.question: Count the distinct nonmissing roll shades.
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT shade) FROM roll

cases.question: For every lot in cut give lot and sum of cut lengths; retain an unknown sum.
cases.sql: SELECT lot,SUM(metres) FROM cut GROUP BY lot

cases.question: Give shade and length for every cut that matches its roll on both key columns.
cases.sql: SELECT r.shade,c.metres FROM cut c JOIN roll r ON c.lot=r.lot AND c.part=r.part

cases.question: Count July 2025 cuts independently of recorded length.
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cut WHERE day>='2025-07-01' AND day<'2025-08-01'

cases.question: For every roll give lot, part and cut count, including uncut rolls.
cases.sql: SELECT r.lot,r.part,COUNT(c.lot) FROM roll r LEFT JOIN cut c ON c.lot=r.lot AND c.part=r.part GROUP BY r.lot,r.part

cases.question: Show artist ids credited to piece 5, keeping every credit.
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM credit WHERE pid=5

cases.question: Count the different pieces with a credit.
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) FROM credit

cases.question: For each piece id in the credit ledger report how many different artists it credits.
cases.sql: SELECT pid,COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM credit GROUP BY pid

cases.question: List the artist nickname and piece title for each credit with both partners present.
cases.sql: SELECT nick,title FROM credit JOIN artist USING(id) JOIN piece USING(pid)

cases.question: Return distinct known artist ids credited in May 2024.
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT id FROM credit WHERE id IS NOT NULL AND day>='2024-05-01' AND day<'2024-06-01'

cases.question: For every artist id, count distinct pieces credited, retaining artists with none.
cases.sql: SELECT a.id,COUNT(DISTINCT c.pid) FROM artist a LEFT JOIN credit c ON a.id=c.id GROUP BY a.id

ddl: posting(team TEXT, booked TEXT, units INTEGER)

cases.question: List team names from all negative postings.
cases.sql: SELECT team FROM posting WHERE units<0

cases.question: Count distinct non-null unit adjustments.
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT units) FROM posting

cases.question: Give each team in posting and its net unit movement.
cases.sql: SELECT team,SUM(units) FROM posting GROUP BY team

cases.question: List team and booked date for individual postings equal to that team's ceiling.
cases.sql: SELECT p.team,p.booked FROM posting p JOIN quota q ON p.team=q.team WHERE p.units=q.ceiling

cases.question: What is the total unit adjustment for September 2025?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(units) FROM posting WHERE booked>='2025-09-01' AND booked<'2025-10-01'

cases.question: For every quota team give the team and number of negative postings including zero.
cases.sql: SELECT q.team,COUNT(p.team) FROM quota q LEFT JOIN posting p ON q.team=p.team AND p.units<0 GROUP BY q.team

cases.question: Which gauge codes recorded a level of zero? Keep repeats.
cases.sql: SELECT code FROM reading WHERE level=0

cases.question: How many distinct known levels have been recorded?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT level) FROM reading

cases.question: List each reading date and its maximum known level.
cases.sql: SELECT d,MAX(level) FROM reading GROUP BY d

cases.question: For known gauges, give basin and date for readings with missing levels.
cases.sql: SELECT basin,d FROM gauge JOIN reading USING(code) WHERE level IS NULL

cases.question: What was the mean known level in March 2025?
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(level) FROM reading WHERE d>='2025-03-01' AND d<'2025-04-01'

cases.question: For every date in waterday give date and number of nonmissing levels including zero.
cases.sql: SELECT w.d,COUNT(r.level) FROM waterday w LEFT JOIN reading r ON w.d=r.d GROUP BY w.d

ddl: firing(f INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER,day TEXT)

cases.question: Return firing ids for all B-grade assays.
cases.sql: SELECT f FROM assay WHERE grade='B'

cases.question: Count the different known assay grades.
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT grade) FROM assay

cases.question: For each firing id recorded in assay show id and number of named grades, counting repeats.
cases.sql: SELECT f,COUNT(grade) FROM assay GROUP BY f

cases.question: Return plant and grade for each assay that can be traced to a firing and kiln.
cases.sql: SELECT plant,grade FROM assay JOIN firing USING(f) JOIN kiln USING(k)

cases.question: List firing ids started during November 2023.
cases.sql: SELECT f FROM firing WHERE day>='2023-11-01' AND day<'2023-12-01'

cases.question: Show every kiln id with its number of firings, even unused kilns.
cases.sql: SELECT k.k,COUNT(f.f) FROM kiln k LEFT JOIN firing f ON k.k=f.k GROUP BY k.k

cases.question: Give dates of visits on which no seeds had been sown.
cases.sql: SELECT day FROM visit WHERE sown=0

cases.question: How many different recorded crops do the beds contain?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT crop) FROM bed

cases.question: For each visited bed id report the sum of living plants over all its visits.
cases.sql: SELECT id,SUM(alive) FROM visit GROUP BY id

cases.question: List the crop for each matched visit with more than half the seeds alive and a positive sow count.
cases.sql: SELECT crop FROM bed JOIN visit USING(id) WHERE sown>0 AND alive*2>sown

cases.question: How many visits took place in February of leap year 2024?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit WHERE day>='2024-02-01' AND day<'2024-03-01'

cases.question: Give each bed id and the number of visits with at least one living plant, including zero.
cases.sql: SELECT b.id,COUNT(v.id) FROM bed b LEFT JOIN visit v ON v.id=b.id AND v.alive>0 GROUP BY b.id
